additional_info.subject: RE: ID0443211-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001197]OCPP connection lost CRM:02681000615
additional_info.body:
Good morning Chloe,
I am reaching out from the Expert Services team in regards of ticket
ID0443211.
Apologies for the late reply.
the ticket was opened for OCPP connection lost on charger
MP/PD 170001197
. Today I connected remotely via SSH to the router, and I saw that the internal modem had an error. I rebooted the router internally from its webUI, and after the reboot the router connected to the internet and now the connection to the backend is re-established.
Since the issue is solved, I will proceed to close this ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
